messages:
ana: Heads-up: route `checkout-v2` hit sampling drop for 7m this morning, customer debug blocked. Quota bot triggered and we defaulted to drop mode.
quota-bot: ALERT: route=checkout-v2 sample_drop_rate=0.88 threshold=0.6 at 2026-06-01T08:14:12Z
mike: Oof. We need more nuance than a hard global sampler. Two quick ideas: (1) per-route escrow tokens (exposure budget), (2) short-lived diagnostic windows with RBAC + audit.
yusuf: Exposing raw captures is scary. Any spend must compute estimated_pii_tokens_exposed and require an approval if above threshold. Also record redaction_profile and redaction_confidence on every sampled event.
claire: Console UX: when a route nears quota show "Diagnostics blocked" and three CTAs: Request burst, Open ephemeral inspect (ops-only), Isolate route. Each CTA shows a privacy delta preview.
devops: API sketch for spend: ```POST /internal/routes/checkout-v2/exposure/spend {"minutes":10,"profile":"diag_full","ticket":"INC-4444","reason":"payment-issue"}``` returns {"before":4200,"after":3600,"delta_estimate":1200}.
mike: Rollout: ops-only flag initially, canary on 5 internal tenants, watch metric: redaction_fail_rate. If redaction_confidence_mean drops >0.1 rollback.
yusuf: Enforcement: if redaction_confidence < 0.7 store only hashed placeholders; do not persist masked text. Also add telemetry field exposure_delta_estimate, and wire spends to security-audit sink with actor/ticket/before/after.
nana: (typo) ana: I can prototype console copy & Figma tomorrow. mike: I'll implement escrow ledger + soft quota alerts. yusuf: I'll add redaction_confidence into sampled envelope and telemetry calc. devops: I'll add CLI `ri ops spend-exposure` that demands ticket and reason and emits immutable audit entry.
claire: One more: show a small inline "privacy score" (0-100) next to route and tooltip linking computation. If score > 70 require 2FA for spends.
nana: Great. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to align API shapes and required audit fields. Closing: every diagnostic spend must create an immutable audit, and no raw payload for low-confidence redaction. :lock:
